scope: Dense Qwen2.5-72B Q4_K_M decode lower-bound analysis for the selected source GGUF and its Metal provider; not a hardware-specification claim.

calculation.assumption: A dense decode token must at minimum access the selected model's 47415715488-byte weight body once. Actual traffic, activations, KV, and non-ideal locality can only increase the required bandwidth.

conclusion.reason: Measured provider paths are 12.96 aggregate and 14.5 single-stream t/s. Reaching 100 t/s would require at least 6.90x the observed effective dense-weight stream and at least 4.74 TB/s of minimum model-weight access before overhead.
allowed_next_classes: verified architecture-aware weight transformation with capability gates
accelerator kernel/runtime work that materially changes effective weight traffic
conclusion.forbidden_inference: This roofline does not prove a hardware maximum or authorize a 100-TPS claim.
